# papa-smurf/Gargul wiki: Rolling Items
## You can start rolling out an item in multiple ways
**1. Alt-Clicking on an item**
The most common and easiest way to start rolling out items is to simply hold your alt button and left click an item in your inventory or a corpse's loot window.
**2. Using a slash command**
Alternatively you can use a slash command followed by the item link (shift click the item): Item Roll Slash Command
You can use one of the following slash commands:
**_/gl rolloff_**
**_/gl roll_**
**_/gl ro_**
**3. Drag & Drop or type item into item box**
The last option is to drag and drop an item into the masterloot window's item editbox or type it there directly (number 1 in the image below)

...

## The masterloot (aka RollOff) window explained
**1.** This edit box holds the itemlink of the item you're rolling off. The icon to the left of it is updated automatically
**2.** This button starts the RollOff at which point all your raiders can start rolling
**3.** This button stops the current RollOff.
New rolls are lo longer tracked at this point
**4.** This edit box holds a note you can add to the RollOff. Some examples are MS/OS or maybe even an item's priority
**5.** In this edit box you can define how much time your raiders should be allowed to roll on the item
**6.** This button clears the RollOff window. This might be useful to clear up all of its content if you don't plan on awarding the item
**7.** After your raiders have rolled you can select one of the rolls in the roll window (number 8) and click this button to award the item **8.** This is the window that holds all of the rolls that came in while the RollOff was in progress
**9.** Here you see all rolls.
Whenever a roll is suffixed by a number in square brackets (e.g. [2] ) then that means that it was not this person's first roll. 2 means that this was his second roll, 3 means third etc.

...

## What do raiders see when I roll out an item?
The first thing your raiders are greeted with is a raid warning or party message:
Raid Warning
Players who have Gargul installed will also be greeted with a small, non-intrusive, roll widget that allows the to easily so what's currently being rolled out:
Roll Widget

## What's that extra button I see as a masterlooter?
Whenever you as a masterlooter start a RollOff and then decide to close the RollOff window, or have the "Close this window when roll starts" setting (number 10) enabled, then an additional button will show up that shows the icon of the item you're currently rolling out.

...

## General notes
**1.** You can safely close the RollOff window after starting a RollOff
**2.** Only you as a masterlooter have to install the addon, it's optional (but very helpful) for your raiders
**3.** You can freely move the three elements described here (RollOff window, roller widget and reopen button).
Their positions will be remembered
**4.** Raiders can right-click the roller widget to hide it if they're not interested in the item or disable it completely in Gargul's settings:
Gargul Roll Window Setting

# papa-smurf/Gargul wiki: Awarding Items
## Awarding items that don't need to be rolled for
You can award items using the UI or by using a slash command. The UI is probably the easiest: hold the _**Alt**_ and _**Shift**_ buttons and _**Left Click**_ an item, either in your inventory or in the loot window of whatever you killed. You will be greeted by the award window:
Award Window
You can also manually open this window by typing on of these slash commands:
_**/gl award**_
_**/gl a**_
Select a player, click the "Award" button and after confirming the dialogue box your item received list will be updated and can be exported to TMB for a hassle-free import of raid loot, more on that [here](https://github.com/papa-smurf/Gargul/wiki/Export-To-TMB) .
If you want to award an item entirely without the UI then you can also type
_**/gl award [playerName] [itemLink]**_
Example:
Award Command Example

## Items that require rolling
If two or more raiders have the same prio on an item you might want to let them roll for it. If that's the case you can hold the _**Alt**_ button and _**Left Click**_ an item, either in your inventory or in the loot window of whatever you killed. You will be greeted by the masterloot window:
Award Window
A full explanation about this window is provided [here](https://github.com/papa-smurf/Gargul/wiki/Rolling-Items) . The most important thing to note here is that it's absolutely necessary to "Award" the item after everyone rolled, by selecting a player and clicking the "Award" button.

# papa-smurf/Gargul wiki: Version Check
Gargul allows you to compare your addon version with everyone in your group and shows you exactly who needs to upgrade or who doesn't have the addon installed.
Gargul might not be necessary for everyone in your raid for most purposes, but if you want to be able to check raiders' inventories for (buff) items etc then this checker will come in handy.
To perform the version check you can use these slash commands:
_**/gl version**_
_**/gl ve**_
The output looks as follows:
Check Version Output

# papa-smurf/Gargul wiki: Importing Soft Reserves
- Page: GitHub wiki page
- URL: https://github.com/papa-smurf/Gargul/wiki/Importing-Soft-Reserves
- Repository: papa-smurf/Gargul
At the time of writing Gargul only supports the importing of soft-reserves made via https://softres.it/
Open your soft-reserve page and click the "Copy Weakaura Data" button:
Copy Weakaura Data
To import your soft-reserves in Gargul you can use any of the following slash commands:
**_/gl softreserves_**
**_/gl so_**
**_/gl sr_**
Paste the softres.it contents in the large edit box you see before you:
gl softreserves edit box
Now click the "Import" button and optionally the "Broadcast" button to share the soft-reserves with everyone in the raid who also has Gargul installed. The "Broadcast" functionality is only available to masterlooters*
That's it! Your soft-reserves have been set up properly!

# papa-smurf/Gargul wiki: Announcing Loot in Chat
## Basics and settings
By default Gargul posts loot drops with soft-reserves (if any) to the raid or party chat whenever the master looter loots a fresh corpse.
This behavior can be altered in Gargul's settings which can be opened by one of the following slash commands:
_**/gl**_
_**/gl settings**_
_**/gl config**_
_**/gl se**_
_**/gl co**_
Or pressing _**escape**_ , clicking on Interface -> AddOns -> Gargul
Loot Announce Settings
You can completely disable this feature by unchecking the "Announce loot to chat" option. You can also define the minimum required quality for items to be announced in chat through the "Minimum announce quality" setting.
Last but not least you can opt out of posting who soft-reserved what to the chat by unchecking the "Include soft reserves in loot announcement" setting.

## What do raiders see?
If you as a masterlooter have everything enabled (default behavior), then looting a corpse with soft-reserved items will result in the following message in raid chat:
Raid Announcement
If any of the items that dropped are on your raider's thatsmybis wishlists then that will also be displayed in chat:
Raid Announcement
If you start a [RollOff](https://github.com/papa-smurf/Gargul/wiki/Rolling-Items) for a soft-reserved item then your raiders will see the following raid warning accompanied with a raid message:
Raid Message
If raiders have Gargul installed then they'll be greeted by a rolling widget as well: Bidding Widget
